note: Per-surface fallback templates. content_role=template on every row. Natal placement renders in TWO PARTS: the planet-in-sign paragraph, then (when a house is known) the house-context paragraph below it. Slots resolve per contracts/CONTENT-ROLE-CONTRACT.json vocabulary families; optional {{#blocks}} are suppressed cleanly when a slot has no eligible row (never filled with generic phrases). Voice: only {{possessive}} varies by viewer ("Your" / "Sofia's"); all slot values are voice-neutral per the grammar-frame contract, so no pronoun conjugation ever happens inside stored data. STYLE RULES: no em dashes; templates are glue only, all slot content is verbatim approved-source wording.

sharedSlots.modifierSentences: list of complete_sentence produced by modifier templates (optional)
sharedSlots.planetRef: fact ('the Sun'/'the Moon' mid-sentence; bare name otherwise)
sharedSlots.placementGerundText: verbatim CC gerund fragments joined with ', or ' (renders as one sentence)
sharedSlots.planetIntro: fallback_hook planet-intro (two plain sentences, dual voice, drafted from source meanings)
sharedSlots.houseLine: vocabulary house-line (one plain sentence per house, drafted from CC house keywords)
sharedSlots.placementClauseText: verbatim CC clauses joined into one sentence: 'It x, and it y.'
